title: Television Producer/Distributor Sandy Frank Dies at 97
content: Frank was born on July 11, 1929. Frank started his career as a sales executive for Paramount Pictures in the late 1940s, then worked at Guild Films and NBC before becoming President of Worldwide Sales at Wrather Corporation. In 1964, he started his own television program syndication company Sandy Frank Program Sales.
author: ANN

title: 3 Iconic Dragon Ball Moments Every Vegeta Fan Needs to Revisit
content: Dragon Ball ‘ s favorite bad boy turned good in Saiyan Prince Vegeta showed time and time again why his story is one of the best in all of anime. The egotistical, murderous, evil Saiyan left all those negative traits to become a lovable family man and protector of the Earth alongside Goku .

title: Shaman King Creator Returns for Surprise New Anime – Watch Trailer
content: Hiroyuki Takei is returning with a brand new anime project this month, and it’s going to be one of his most unique works so far. Shaman King may not have received the anime adaptation it deserved, but it remains one of the most beloved Shonen Jump series of all time.

title: All-Female Troupe Takarazuka Revue to Perform Musical for My Happy Marriage Series
content: The musical stars Sea Towaki as Kiyoka and Misaki Hoshizora as Miyo. Daisuke Tabuchi is directing the musical. The musical will run alongside the TAKARAZUKA SPECTACULAR『MANHATTAN FOLLIES』－Seize The Day－ show. The My Happy Marriage television anime adaptation's first season premiered in July 2023 with 12 episodes.
